steps.eyebrow: A little clarity, at every step
steps.title: Before, during and beyond your visit.
steps.body: Care is more than a single conversation. Explore how a connected journey can make the next step easier to understand.

items.title: Prepare with purpose
items.body: Write down your questions, gather the information your clinic requests and understand what you would like to discuss.

items.title: Make room to talk
items.body: Bring your concerns to a qualified care professional. Ask about options, expectations and anything that needs explaining.

items.title: Leave with a next step
items.body: Clarify your care plan, follow-up arrangements and who to contact if you have questions after the conversation.

services.title: Less searching. More understanding.
services.body: Explore the platform’s capabilities. Your clinic and verified service activation determine which tools are available to you.

clinicians.title: Care is a team effort.
clinicians.body: From preparation to follow-up, clear context and thoughtful coordination help teams keep the person at the center of the visit.

trust.title: Your information deserves careful handling.
trust.body: Understand the platform’s boundaries before you share personal information. This public website provides information; account and clinical services are currently unavailable.

items.title: Understand your privacy
items.body: Read how information is handled and which choices and requests are described in the privacy notice.

items.title: Know who can help
items.body: Clinical questions belong with a qualified professional. This website cannot diagnose, prescribe or provide emergency care.

items.title: Check availability first
items.body: Do not submit health records or payment information here. A participating clinic must confirm access before you use clinical tools.

items.question: Can I book a consultation on this website?
items.answer: Account and clinical services are currently unavailable on this public site. A participating clinic must confirm an active service and your access before a booking can be made.

items.question: Who is MediConnect designed for?
items.answer: The platform is designed around patients, clinicians and clinic teams, with separate workspaces for their different responsibilities.

items.question: Should I upload my health records here?
items.answer: No. Do not submit health records, payment information or other sensitive details on this public site. Read the privacy notice and confirm the appropriate secure channel with your clinic.

items.question: Where can I find information about preparing for care?
items.answer: Explore the Guides section for general educational reading. It supports your understanding and does not replace advice from a qualified care professional.

items.question: What should I do in an emergency?
items.answer: Contact your local emergency services immediately. Do not wait for a website response or use MediConnect as an emergency service.

closing.title: A clearer next step starts here.
closing.body: Learn how the platform works, explore general care guides or find answers about availability before you go further.
